ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) patches; visual ratio is approximately 75% dark to 25% white.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions are localized on the distal trailing edges of both lobes. The white patch on the right lobe is significantly more expansive (occupying approximately the outer third) than the patch on the left lobe (occupying approximately the outer sixth). The central and proximal regions are uniformly low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped median notch with an interior angle of approximately 70 degrees and a vertical depth measuring roughly 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge boundary. Several larger, non-uniform indentations (notches) are visible on the upper distal edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a broad, slightly convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, resulting in a wide, tapered profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10-15 circular or ring-shaped high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) primarily distributed across the central and right-central dark regions. Distinct clusters of high-intensity, textured bumps (barnacles) are visible at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density network of intersecting, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) occurring across the majority of the dark-pigmented fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks and circular rosette scars distributed globally; visible barnacle colonization localized on the far left and right distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry characterized by a much larger area of white mottling on the right lobe trailing edge compared to the left.
